verdict.rationale: Google Voice's documented ring groups let several people in an organization answer calls on the same number, including round-robin distribution, and authorized users can place outbound calls from the group's number. That covers only the shared-number part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents presence, conversation assignment or ownership, or internal team threads on shared conversations. Missing for 10: agent presence/availability status, conversation assignment to specific teammates, internal notes/threads on shared conversations, shared SMS inbox evidence, independent corroboration.
